propositions: Implement `rebar metrics` subcommand accepting `--since`, `--until`, and `--output json|text` flags that renders all registered metrics over the specified date range

The metrics command must import the `rebar.metrics` package (not just registry) to trigger full REGISTRY hydration via reader module side-effects, then call `evaluate()` for each MetricSpec with a context object containing repo_root, since, and until
Wrap each metric evaluation in try-except to render failing metrics as unavailable rather than crashing the entire command, ensuring every registered id appears in output

JSON output format returns dict with `since`, `until`, and `metrics` map; each metric entry contains either value/source/confidence/lens or unavailable with reason/accruing_since; text output prints one line per metric in registry order
The metrics command must not import any `rebar.metrics.adapters` module (enforced by test assertion on source code), maintaining adapter isolation
CLI help text, overview registration, dispatch wiring, test coverage, and generated documentation must be updated together to make the subcommand discoverable and verified by drift guards
